description: Instance data against explicit application constraints declared in the audit schema sidecar: types, literal values, cardinality, disjointness, irreflexivity and materialized entailments, with the vocabulary, structure, unit and competency checks. CON001 to CON005 are required, so a store without those declarations gets an indeterminate gate rather than a pass; CON006 applies only where materialization is declared. Absence is a violation only within the declared closed-world scope.
